description: A Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.3 that savestates the entire game

mods.name: DreamManhunt
mods.description: Full-fidelity savestates for client and server: save the whole game, open the menu, and continue from any saved moment.

releases.notes:
**DreamManhunt: Savestate Mod Release v1.1.0** :tada:

Today we announce the release of Major Version 1.1.0, available on our [GitHub](<https://github.com/Swofty-Developments/DreamsManhuntMod/>) and downloadable from our [Releases](<https://github.com/Swofty-Developments/DreamsManhuntMod/releases/tag/v1.1.0>).

Changelog:
- Mining a block across a restore continues from the saved progress on both server and client, and the block breaks on the same tick as uncut play
- Mobs keep their AI across a restore: goals, pathfinding, brain memories and behaviours, combat trackers, line of sight and the order they tick in
- World simulation stays on the uncut timeline: pistons mid-move, scheduled ticks in their original order, random ticks, spawning order and the level random
- A restore resumes only once every saved chunk and entity is ticking again, and ends at once when nobody is left on the server
- Players keep their open container, portal timer, fishing bobber, chat session, spectator target and every server-side movement and combat counter
- Server entity trackers and client interpolation are restored, so every entity is drawn where it would be without the cut
- Unconfirmed block placements are dropped when a restore begins, so no ghost blocks are left behind
- A dual-timeline harness checks server and client state tick by tick across a restore

Contributors:
- [Swofty-Developments](<https://github.com/Swofty-Developments/>)

releases.notes:
**DreamManhunt: Savestate Mod Release v1.0.0** :tada:

Today we announce the release of Major Version 1.0.0, available on our [GitHub](<https://github.com/Swofty-Developments/DreamsManhuntMod/>) and downloadable from our [Releases](<https://github.com/Swofty-Developments/DreamsManhuntMod/releases/tag/v1.0.0>).

Changelog:
- Savestates for Minecraft 26.3 on Fabric: press K to save the whole game, press J and click a savestate to continue from it, in singleplayer and on dedicated servers
- Every connected client restores with the server, and the server holds everyone frozen until every client is ready
- Restores put back the world, every player, advancements, statistics, scoreboards, inventories, cooldowns, items in use, entity ids and weather transitions, and roll back if they fail
- Client restores put back the HUD tick counter behind hunger-bar jolts and heart shake, animated textures, glints, particles, mob and block entity animations, chat fade timing, toasts, open screens and settings
- Every pseudorandom generator is saved and restored, and generators the game seeds from the clock draw from a restorable seed stream
- Music, records, ambience and every playing sound resume at their exact sample offset
- A green cut marker covers every frozen frame of a restore
- Release bundles: the mod jar, a ready-to-run Fabric server and a Prism Launcher instance

Contributors:
- [Swofty-Developments](<https://github.com/Swofty-Developments/>)
